title: glechoma linearis
intro: Glechoma linearis, commonly known as Creeping Jenny, is a perennial plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cognitive function due to its antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Glechoma linearis include its use in treating anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues, as well as its potential application in wound healing and skin regeneration. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and pharmacological actions.
